stem: A chemical container has an unreadable label and no verified identity. What is the correct action?
choices: Smell it to identify the material.
Compare its color with known products and proceed.
Do not use it; isolate/hold it according to procedure and obtain verified identity and hazard information.
Use a small amount to see how the batch responds.
rationale: Do not use it; isolate/hold it according to procedure and obtain verified identity and hazard information.
